triggers.text: at the start of your turn
at the end of your opponent's turn, you may use this ability
at the start of your Command phase
at the end of your Shooting phase, if the unit is below half strength
each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 9" of this model
before a Hit roll is made for an attack made by this model
each time an attack made by a model in a friendly unit scores a wound (the triggering unit must have INFANTRY)
when an enemy unit is destroyed in melee by this unit
when the unit is selected to shoot during your opponent's Shooting phase
each time you use a Stratagem within Engagement Range of this unit
